project.name: Inspecto — Prometheus scrape endpoint (Standard edition, optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL Standard-edition metrics EXPOSITION (EDITIONS.md CP-13): GET /metrics, the Prometheus text endpoint, contributed through the core's public com.gamma.control.RouteModule ServiceLoader seam.
WHY ONLY THE EXPOSITION (EDG-01 cell 5, 2026-09-07). MetricRegistry is called by nine classes across three modules outside its own package -- CollectorProcessor, JobService, PipelineScheduler, EventLog, MetricsService and more -- so the instrumentation is load-bearing core plumbing and stays in inspecto-event. This module carries the HTTP surface alone; that is why CP-13 is a partial by nature, not by choice.
The gap it closes is real: /metrics sits in ControlApi.PUBLIC_PATHS (unauthenticated -- scrapers carry no token) while Personal ships no authenticator and binds every interface by default, so a Personal install served its full operational telemetry to any host that could reach the port.
Built only under the "edition-standard"/"edition-enterprise" profiles, so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal, the DEFAULT build) never compiles it.
